name: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd
title: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd - 507717 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up ~9% to Rs 483 cr, but record EBITDA margin was flattered by a one-off GST refund (Rs 14.5 cr in Q4); management guides FY27 lower double-digit growth with ~100 bps gross-margin pressure.

triggers.label: Q1 price increase ~2%, Q2 another 3-4%
triggers.quote: Q1, overall price increase may be in the range of around 2%.

triggers.label: Strategic buying lifts inventory
triggers.quote: this 31st March inventory you would see is significantly higher to last year.

triggers.label: Dahej FY27 revenue cut to Rs 75 cr
triggers.quote: this year we are forecasting a revenue of Rs. 75 crores, lower than our earlier estimate of Rs. 100 crores.

triggers.label: Gross margin held, no expansion FY27
triggers.quote: I am not expecting any expansion in the gross margin in the current financial year.

guidance.quote: this year we are forecasting a revenue of Rs. 75 crores, lower than our earlier estimate of Rs. 100 crores.
